turns.question: What were our sales on 1 October 2026?
turns.answer: "Sales" can mean gross or net, so here are both for 1 October 2026: revenue (gross) was 981.69 EUR and net revenue (revenue minus partner returns) was 964.19 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: I mean net sales, after returns.
turns.answer: Net revenue on 1 October 2026 was 964.19 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
